players.product: High-speed copper / fiber-optic / power interconnects + CPO connectivity (incl. CommScope)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K backlog: Amphenol estimates its backlog of unfilled firm orders at approximately $8.9 billion as of December 31, 2025 versus approximately $6.1 billion as of December 31, 2024; the increase was primarily related to strong demand for its products that support AI applications, as well as contributions from its acquisition program. Nearly all of the backlog is expected to be filled within the next 12 months.

10-K: capital expenditures were $996.6 in 2025 versus $665.4 in 2024 (dollars in millions). The elevated 2025 capital expenditures were driven by investments primarily in support of robust growth in the IT datacom market, and Amphenol expects this elevated level of capital spending to continue into 2026 to support growth related to AI applications in IT datacom. At December 31, 2025 it operated approximately 350 manufacturing facilities with approximately 35 million square feet, of which approximately 15 million square feet were for the Communications Solutions segment.
